evidence_profile.applicability: The specific dimaleate marker and targeted role are compatible. evidence_profile.methods_and_comparators: E05: twice-bleached purchased Caucasian tresses, 10% product/hair mass, one-minute massage, four-minute reaction, brushing and 48-hour conditioning; three tresses per condition, 25 fibres, no vehicle/active-isolation comparator. Not the current three-minute product protocol. E03 full comparator/commercial-agent applicability is unavailable.
evidence_profile.contrary_evidence: E03 challenges broad direct crosslinking/disulfide explanations under its tested conditions but uses a dimethyl maleate model not identical to the dimaleate ingredient and unresolved commercial agents. It is contextual, not blanket evidence of no current-product benefit.

Low is also not dependable while meaningful related empirical findings and unresolved applicability could support a narrower benefit. The balanced low/medium question requires hold, without importing reputation.
